primary.status: team proposal, not a final decision
primary.rain: lagged only: rain_lag_1 and rain_roll3 through t-1; no same-month nowcast

adwin: local Bifet-Gavalda cut; river is not installed; a window shorter than 32 points is not cut
adwin_bound: The cut assumes values on [0, 1]. Province absolute errors are not on that scale.

seed_method.protocol: For month t, fit on 2019-01 through t-1 and score t. The fit does not see t.
seed_method.oos_expanding_2019_2024: Every scored month from 2019-02 through 2024-12. Early 2019 fits use fewer than 12 training months.
seed_method.oos_expanding_2023_2024: The same series restricted to 2023-01..2024-12. Each of those months has at least 48 training months.
seed_method.unseeded: The 12 monthly WAPE values of 2025 are shorter than the 32-point cut, so that seed cannot alarm.
